newsitem.title: UK: BFI down 15 as Panamaxes soften further.
newsitem.headline: BFI down 15 as Panamaxes soften further.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down 15 to 1,326 points on Thursday as brokers reported softer conditions for Panamaxes in South America and the Far East.

Hanjin fixed 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for mid-Aug at a weaker $22.25 no combo but brokers pointed out that the vessel concerned Ever Praise was 1981-built and therefore a discount would have been built into the rate for a vessel over 15 years of age.
The 1983-built Sea Pride 66,980 dwt was fixed by Navix for coal delivery Gladstone mid Aug trip Japan at only $8,000 daily plus $130,000 bonus.
Weaker conditions also prevailed for Handy-sizes in the Atlantic and the Baltic Handy Index fell seven points to 998, below 1,000 for the first time since its inception at the start of 1997.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was unchanged to 10 points higher and turnover totalled 50 lots.
